name: Thijs Reuten, Nina Carberry - § 250
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement
part_text: Warmly welcomes the EU-UK Security and Defence Partnership as a key framework for broad EU-UK cooperation in the fields of security and defence, jointly addressing common threats and covering areas including information and intelligence sharing, military mobility, security and defence initiatives, space security, crisis management, cyber defence, hybrid threats, counterterrorism, foreign manipulation of information and interference;
